name: Kevin P Clark
current_role: Chair and CEO, Aptiv PLC; director of Versigent PLC and UPS
profile: Finance executive who joined Delphi as CFO in 2010, became COO in 2014 and CEO in March 2015, steering Delphi's 2017 split into Aptiv and Delphi Technologies; chair since 2022. In April 2026 he completed the spin-off of Aptiv's Electrical Distribution Systems unit as Versigent (NYSE: VGNT), refocusing Aptiv on software, sensing and electrification.
interesting_fact: Under Clark, Aptiv spun off its wiring-harness business as Versigent on April 1, 2026 (one VGNT share per three APTV shares), his second major break-up of the former Delphi after the 2017 Aptiv/Delphi Technologies split.
deep_cut_fact: Before Delphi he was Fisher Scientific's CFO from its 2001 IPO through the 2006 Thermo Electron merger, then a founding partner of middle-market private-equity firm Liberty Lane Partners; he began his career in Chrysler's finance organization and holds two Michigan State degrees.
notes: Sitting public-company CEO; route via Aptiv corporate communications. Aptiv's electrification/high-voltage and data-center-adjacent electronics are possible podcast angles.
